title: The Jelly That Would Not Set
central_conflict: the festival fruit jelly stayed liquid even after a cold night
decisive_choice: fresh kiwi contained an enzyme that prevented the gelatin from setting
resolution: heated the kiwi before mixing a new batch and served firm jelly
story_beats: At the library courtyard, fox and rabbit discovered the festival fruit jelly stayed liquid even after a cold night during a power outage, leaving the community helpers waiting.
Rabbit tried to isolate the problem first, but they added more gelatin but the dessert still flowed off every plate; fox stopped the attempt before further damage.
Fox compared the failed attempt with the evidence and realized fresh kiwi contained an enzyme that prevented the gelatin from setting; they planned a safer joint response.
With the community helpers watching, they heated the kiwi before mixing a new batch and served firm jelly, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

title: The Choir That Sang Behind the Beat
central_conflict: every singer at the concert followed the conductor a beat too late
decisive_choice: the new wireless rehearsal monitors were delaying what singers heard
resolution: switched to a direct monitor feed and rehearsed the opening together
story_beats: At the library courtyard, fox and rabbit discovered every singer at the concert followed the conductor a beat too late during a power outage, leaving the community helpers waiting.

title: The Auction With Two Winners
central_conflict: two neighbors both believed they had won the same charity auction
decisive_choice: a numbered paddle looked like six from one side and nine from the other
resolution: replaced the ambiguous paddle and repeated the bidding fairly
story_beats: At the library courtyard, fox and rabbit discovered two neighbors both believed they had won the same charity auction during a power outage, leaving the community helpers waiting.
Rabbit tried to isolate the problem first, but they counted the raised paddles again but the disagreement grew; fox stopped the attempt before further damage.
Fox compared the failed attempt with the evidence and realized a numbered paddle looked like six from one side and nine from the other; they planned a safer joint response.
With the community helpers watching, they replaced the ambiguous paddle and repeated the bidding fairly, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.
